body:
The docs (SKILL.md compatibility, README) claim Python 3.8+, but two APIs require 3.9:
- cli.py:244 uses argparse.BooleanOptionalAction (added 3.9) for `log --reverse`
- integrity.py:230 uses Path.is_relative_to (added 3.9)

The parser is built unconditionally, so on 3.8 EVERY command crashes at parser-build time, not just `log`.

Fix either way:
(a) bump the documented floor to 3.9+ in SKILL.md and README (3.8 is EOL since Oct 2024), or
(b) replace both call sites with 3.8-safe equivalents (manual --no-reverse flag; try/except ValueError around relative_to).

Option (a) is cheaper and honest. Consider a dev-only `vermin` check to keep the claimed floor true (see CI ticket).
title: Fix Python 3.9-only APIs or bump documented floor to 3.9
